_comment: Single source of truth for all Taste the World events. Edit this file (directly on GitHub or locally) to add / update / remove events. The site renders Upcoming vs Past automatically based on each event's `date`. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD.

events.title: Japan Day — Sushi Stories
events.description: Travel to Japan through one of the world's most iconic foods. Share the story of sushi, from its origins to the colorful art it is today — and then teach everyone how to roll their own.

events.title: Italy Day — Tiramisu Tales
events.description: Espresso, mascarpone, cocoa and a name that means "pick me up." We'll explore Italian café culture and layer up our own tiramisu together.

events.title: Mexico Day — Taco Time & Día de los Muertos
events.description: Tacos meet Día de los Muertos! November 1–2 is Mexico's Day of the Dead — a colorful celebration honoring loved ones with food, flowers, and stories. We'll explore the tradition, press fresh tortillas, mix salsas, and build our own tacos. Pick a filling, fold, fiesta!
ingredients: Chicken or beef (or beans for veggie)

events.title: Korea Day — Bibimbap Bowls
events.description: "Mixed rice" in a bowl of color — meet bibimbap. We'll prep five veggie toppings, learn what each one means, then mix it all up the Korean way.
ingredients: Spinach, carrots, zucchini, bean sprouts, mushrooms

events.title: International Day
events.description: A potluck of flavors — every family brings one dish with a story. Music, posters, and a passport stamp for every taste.
ingredients: Bring one dish from your family's heritage
A short story or memory about the dish (1–2 minutes)

events.title: Senior Home Visit — Foods of Generations Past
events.description: We visit a local senior home to listen, cook, and share. Elders tell the stories of the foods that shaped their lives; kids cook alongside them and bring dishes to share. A reminder that every recipe carries a memory.
ingredients: Ingredient list will depend on what dishes the elders choose to share
We'll share a final list 1 week before the visit

events.title: China Day
events.description: A full afternoon of Chinese cuisine and culture — dumplings, noodles, tea, stories, and games. Bring the family!
ingredients: Ground pork or chicken (or tofu/mushroom for veggie)
Soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar
Tea leaves for a tea-tasting station

events.title: Team Mission Season
events.description: Teams form and draw a mission — a country, a dish, a story. Over three months, kids research the history, study the foods and stories from every past Taste the World episode and event (it's needed for the quiz round!), bring their mission to life in any form their crew chooses — talk, skit, stage play, song, poster, video — and practice cooking the dish. Junior Chefs lead, Mini Chefs learn.
ingredients: To be decided by each team based on their drawn mission

events.title: Team Showcase & Competition
events.description: The big day! Each team shares their country and dish however they've chosen — story, skit, stage play, song, video, or anything in between (Showcase, 80 pts); then a fast-paced food-knowledge quiz round on every past dish and story (Quiz, 20 pts); and finally the awards ceremony. The winning team takes home a **$50 gift card** — and bragging rights until next season.
ingredients: Each team brings ingredients for their chosen dish
Organizers provide quiz materials and prizes
